BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to electric vehicle charging stations; adding a newsection to chapter 46.08 RCW; adding new sections to chapter 46.04 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An electric vehicle charging station must be indicated by avertical sign identifying the space as an electric vehicle chargingstation and indicating that there is no parking other than for electricvehicle charging. The sign must be consistent with the manual onuniform traffic control devices, published by the federal highwayadministration. Additionally, the electric vehicle charging stationmust be indicated by green pavement markings. The sign may includeother information including, but not limited to, the amount of themonetary penalty under section 4 of this act for parking in the spacewhile not connected to an electrical outlet.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Plugin electric vehicle" means a vehicle that is designed to berecharged by plugging into an electrical outlet.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Electric vehicle charging station" means a parking space thatprovides an electrical outlet for the purpose of charging a pluginelectric vehicle.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is a traffic infraction, with a monetary penalty of two hundredfifty dollars, for any person to park a vehicle in an electric vehiclecharging station provided on private property without charge or onpublic property reserved for plugin electric vehicle charging if thevehicle is not connected to an electrical outlet.
